story: HT-008 — Geographic Map View with Leaflet.js

fix_verification.prior_status: OPEN — Critical. map.getSize()={x:0,y:0}; tile max-width clamped to 0px by Tailwind @layer base.

evidence.visual: Dark CartoDB tiles and blue marker fully visible on initial page load — no black canvas

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC1 — /map renders a usable full-viewport map surface on fresh load
acceptance_criteria_verdicts.evidence: Dark CartoDB tiles visible immediately on navigation to /map. Zoom controls present. Leaflet/OSM/CARTO attribution rendered. getSize()={x:1642,y:722}. BUG-001 is resolved.

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC2 — Geo-location markers with tooltip showing location name and device count
acceptance_criteria_verdicts.evidence: Hover on marker: a11y description updates to 'HT008 Geo 16584a • 1 device'. Tooltip StaticText confirmed in DOM snapshot. Non-geo location (rack type, null lat/lng) correctly absent from map.

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC3 — Marker click opens right-side panel with location name and device list
acceptance_criteria_verdicts.evidence: Native click on marker element opened 'Location details' complementary panel. Panel contents: location name 'HT008 Geo 16584a', '1 device' count, device button 'HT008 DEVICE 961E9C' (Server), 'Close location details' button. All correct.

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC4 — Device click from panel navigates to topology with device selected and detail panel open

evidence.navigation: PASS — clicking device button navigated to /topology?device_id=40cb4767-97a5-4c9a-b669-919713db5197 correctly.
evidence.device_pre_selection: NOT IMPLEMENTED — window._cy.getElementById(device_id) returns 0 elements. Target device is not placed on the default topology canvas. No device detail panel opened. The story notes explicitly acknowledge this: 'HT-003 topology page must honour the device_id query param and pre-select that node (add this to HT-003 follow-up if missing)'. This is a known HT-003 dependency, not a regression introduced by the BUG-001 fix.

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC5 — Empty state when no geo locations exist
acceptance_criteria_verdicts.evidence: Rack-type location (null lat/lng) correctly produces no map marker — filter logic verified. Full empty-state card ('No geographic locations yet — add a location…') not testable without a data-less environment.

acceptance_criteria_verdicts.ac: AC6 — Marker clustering with >10 nearby locations
acceptance_criteria_verdicts.evidence: Only 1 geo marker in DB. MarkerCluster JS loads HTTP 200. Clustering cannot be exercised with current data. Not a blocker for story closure.

informational_notes.title: Map starts at zoom=19 (max) when only 1 geo marker exists — zoom-in button disabled
informational_notes.detail: fitBounds on a single point causes Leaflet to zoom to max level (19). This is expected Leaflet behaviour for single-point bounds. Zoom-out works. Not a defect — will self-correct once >1 geo markers are present.

informational_notes.title: AC4 device pre-selection is an unimplemented HT-003 dependency
informational_notes.detail: The /topology page does not honour device_id query param for auto-select + panel open. This was explicitly scoped as a HT-003 follow-up in the HT-008 story notes. Not a HT-008 defect.

verdict_rationale: The sole critical blocker (BUG-001: black map on fresh load) is definitively resolved. AC1 now passes on a fresh browser load. AC2 and AC3 pass with live interaction. AC4 navigation passes; the device pre-selection sub-requirement is a known HT-003 dependency explicitly noted in the story as a follow-up, not a HT-008 regression. AC5 and AC6 are not testable with current data but are not blocking criteria given the story's scope. No new bugs introduced by the fix.
